title: Reader and verifier prompt sets sit at 1997/2000 and 1298/1300 tokens; 7 prompt jobs failed while adding text inside these budgets

brief.question: Raise the reader and verifier prompt token budgets about 5% (change D25) so new rules have room?
brief.if_yes: Small prompt additions fit without cutting existing rules. Fewer prompt jobs get rejected for lost meaning.
brief.if_no: Every addition still needs a trim first. Prompt jobs keep failing on cuts that change meaning.
brief.cost: About 100 more prompt tokens per reader call and 65 per verifier call (estimate). Less pressure to keep prompts short.
brief.recommendation: Yes: the budgets are 99.8% full and 7 jobs failed on this, despite a reading-side fix already queued.
